records.text: By evening, weekend, or whenever called, he is Lieutenant Colonel Peterson (Val Peterson) at the Utah Army National Guard. During a change of command ceremony on Saturday at the Utah Army National Guard's Draper headquarters, Peterson (Val Peterson) assumed command of the 300th Military Intelligence Brigade, a linguist and intelligence unit headquartered in Utah that has nearly 2,000 language specialist troops in six states.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
